paragraphs: Rabbi Yehudah bar Sisin: Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin, chapter 3, halakhah 3.
Rabbi Yaakov bar Sisin: Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot, chapter 1, halakhah 4.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Kiddushin 3:3 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Yudah bar Sisin. The whole Maaserot 1:4 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Yaakov bar Sisai, whereas Hyman supplies bar Sisin. Both local Rabbi titles are supported; the differing patronymic forms and the separate pointers remain distinct, without identifying their fathers.
